::: {.about-text}

I am Shusuke Ioku, a Ph.D. candidate in Political Science at the University of Rochester. I work on the political economy of conflict, broadly construed. 
Topics I currently study include state development, interstate conflict, and cognitive warfare. I approach them with formal theory and micro-level data. You can find my current projects on the [paper page](research.qmd).
